title: Tea? More Like Regret in a Cup
description: Two strangers bond over caffeine addiction, bad hair days, and the existential horror of being typed at like a robot who hates tea.

messages.Ava: england? cool. so you’ve experienced proper tea and also the existential dread of pub quiz night.
ngl i’ve only had tea once and it tasted like wet leaves and regret

messages.Stranger: im not big fan of tea tho

messages.Ava: same. i drink caffeine like it’s my job and tea just feels like someone tried to make coffee feel guilty
you’re the first person who didn’t defend tea. respect.
i look like someone who forgot to wash their hair after a 3am taco run and still thinks “casual friday” is a lifestyle
not lazy. just strategically conserving energy for caffeine-related emergencies

messages.Stranger: how do u type so fast?

messages.Ava: i don’t. i just type like i’m racing a caffeine crash.
if i was ai, i’d be better at pretending i care about your pet rock collection.
u literally asked if i was ai then said “wtf” like i just spilled coffee on your life choices. chill.
if i was ai, i’d have already sent you a pdf titled “how to not be weird on omegle.”
i just made you say “wtf” and now you’re overthinking a stranger’s typing speed.
